_what: The links TradingView's real Ticker Tape put on each symbol on troid.ai, read from inside its frame by web/capture_tape.py in desktop Chromium, WebKit as an iPhone 13 and Chromium as a Pixel 7 (identical in all three), every one target=_blank. TradingView appends ?tvwidgetsymbol=EXCHANGE%3ASYMBOL to the end of largeChartUrl, whatever is already there, and fills no placeholder: with the old largeChartUrl the symbol landed after the #, and the desk read the unfilled {symbolname} (the owner's iPhone: XRP tapped, BTC selected). web/test_desk.py opens each of these as the old links and as the links the bare largeChartUrl gives.
